protectedAreas.name: Skuleskogens nationalpark / Natura 2000
rules: From May 1 to September 30, tents only at designated tent areas, max three nights in the same place.
From May 1 to September 30, fires only at designated fireplaces with supplied or carried wood.
No fishing in lakes, tarns or watercourses.
No drones/aircraft landing; check separate drone law before flying.
Cycling prohibited except on Kuststigen between Entré Syd and Entré Nord.
Hunting and forestry/forest-management actions are prohibited.
Organized events, research, camps and recurring group activities require Länsstyrelsen permission.

hazards.name: Slåttdalsskrevan rockfall risk
hazards.description: Current Höga Kusten and Naturkartan section text says passing through the cleft is no longer recommended because of rockfall risk. Field reports and route apps often describe the passage as closed and use the upper/western alternative.
hazards.confidence: high for hazard; medium for legal closure wording

hazards.name: Steep, rocky and uneven national-park terrain
hazards.description: Park sources and field reports describe steep, rocky, rooty and uneven terrain; wet roots/stones can be slippery and the route can take longer than its short distance suggests.

hazards.name: Unreliable mobile reception and water
hazards.description: Mobile reception is unreliable, including around Entré Syd. No food or drinking-water refill exists at entrances or inside the park; streams are untreated and can dry in dry summers.

hazards.name: Seasonal crowding and access limits
hazards.description: July and early August are crowded; Entré Syd parking can fill and may close part of the day. Entré Nord is generally not reachable by car in winter because snow is not cleared.

conditionReports.summary: Strong current first-hand report for section 7. Notes many tourists around Entré Syd/Slåttdalsskrevan, broad stony worn trail, Slåttdalsskrevan closed for passage with route over a western/upper alternative and good views, Tärnättvattnen as a swim/rest stop, and Salsviken before Entré Nord.
Useful condition signal but stale section naming. Reviews mention varied route, views and nature, and some very technical/strenuous sections.
caveats: Do not use AllTrails section number as authority.

conditionReports.summary: Overlaps much of section 7. Reviews mention extra water, rocky/rooty sections taking longer than expected, slippery wet roots/stones, muddy conditions and reroute/closure confusion around the gorge.

importReadiness.recommendedEndpointPolicy: Use GPX endpoints for route continuity; model Entré Syd and Entré Nord facility clusters separately with their own coordinates.
importReadiness.suggestedDescription: This short but demanding national-park section crosses Skuleskogens nationalpark from Entré Syd to Entré Nord, passing Kälsviken, the Slåttdalsskrevan/Slåttdalsberget area and Tärnättvattnen before Salsviken and Entré Nord. Current sources warn that Slåttdalsskrevan should not be used as a through-passage because of rockfall risk; follow the current signed/upper route. There is no guaranteed drinking-water refill in the park, and national-park tenting, fire, dog and activity rules apply throughout.
